verdict.rationale: The first-party agent-testing docs say developers can verify conversational responses, tool usage and full multi-turn outcomes before deploying, and can turn underperforming real conversations into test cases. Agent analysis adds custom success-evaluation criteria for judging conversation quality and goal achievement. Missing for 10: details of how simulated users or personas drive the multi-turn tests, any evidence of phone or telephony-specific testing before going live, programmatic or CI-style test runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
